## `startReview` (line 903)

**Setup and DB record creation:**
- Calls `getPrDetail(repo.fullName, prNumber)` (`gh-cli.ts`) to fetch PR metadata including head/base SHAs (line 915).
- Calls `ensureReviewSeries` to upsert a `pr_review_series` row (line 919).
- Calls `getLatestSuccessfulReviewBaseline` to find the prior successful review, enabling incremental mode logic (line 919).
- Decides `tentativeMode` (`'full'` vs `'incremental'`) based on whether head/base SHAs changed since the last run (lines 922-926).
- Inserts a `pr_reviews` row with status `'running'` (lines 927-951).
- Fires `runParallelReview` **without awaiting** (line 999) and returns the `PrReview` record immediately to the caller.

---

## `runParallelReview` (line 1017) -- the real orchestration

### 1. Worktree creation
`createPrWorktree` (line 1039) runs `git fetch origin pull/<N>/head` then `git worktree add` under `~/.pylon/worktrees/<repo>/pr-<N>-<reviewId>`. Falls back to fetching by branch name on failure. Uses Node `execFileAsync` directly (no external module).

### 2. Diff fetching and scope resolution (line 1049)
`resolveReviewScope` from **`./review-scope`** computes the actual diff:
- Full mode: diffs base..head via `gh pr diff` or `git diff`.
- Incremental mode: diffs `previousHeadSha..currentHeadSha` to cover only new commits.
Returns `scope.diff`, `scope.files`, and final `reviewMode`. Result is written back to DB via `updateReviewScopeMetadata` / `persistReviewRunFiles` (lines 1055-1056).

### 3. Diff chunking (line 1066-1078)
`getTokenBudget` and `chunkDiff` from **`./diff-chunker`** split the diff into token-budget-bounded chunks, skipping lock files and generated files. Each chunk carries its own file list. `skippedFiles` are noted in progress messages.

### 4. Context building (lines 1125-1203)
Resolves one of two backends:
- **`McpContextBackend`** (from `./pr-context/mcp-context-backend`) wrapping **`CodeIntelligenceMcpClient`** (`./pr-context/mcp-client`), if an MCP config is present.
- **`HeuristicContextBackend`** (`./pr-context/heuristic-context-backend`) as fallback.

Both are handed to **`PrContextBuilder`** (`./pr-context/pr-context-builder`), which is called with the diff, worktree path, and PR metadata. It enriches context with symbol definitions, references, and related tests, then broadcasts progress over `IPC.GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE`. Failures are caught gracefully; agents proceed without the bundle.

### 5. Parallel specialist agents (lines 1205-1217)
One `runAgentSession` call per `ReviewFocus` (e.g. `security`, `bugs`, `performance`, ...) launched together via `Promise.allSettled`. Each agent:
- Creates an isolated provider session via `sessionManager.createSession` with the optional MCP config injected as `mcpServers.code-intelligence` (line 1684).
- Sets permission mode to `'auto-approve'` and effort level.
- Iterates over diff chunks. For chunk 0 calls `buildPrReviewFirstChunkPrompt`; for subsequent chunks calls `buildPrReviewContinuationPrompt` -- both from **`./pr-review-prompts`** (lines 1724-1740).
- Streams token deltas via `sessionManager.onMessage`, accumulated in `agentSession.streamedText` using `extractReviewOutputText` / `appendReviewOutputText` from **`./pr-review-output`**.
- Stops early on context-limit errors, collecting partial results.
- After all chunks, calls `parseFindings` on the full streamed text and tags each finding with its `domain` (focus area).

The worktree is cleaned up via `removePrWorktree` in a `finally` block after all agents settle (line 1224).

### 6. Deduplication (line 1249)
`deduplicateFindings` from **`./pr-review-dedupe`** merges near-duplicate findings across agents using title/file/line proximity.

### 7. Critic pass (line 1253, method `runCriticPass`)
Implements a generator+critic self-consistency pattern:
- `partitionForCritic` from **`./pr-review-critic`** splits findings into `autoKept` (blockers + high severity) and `candidates` (everything else).
- Builds a focused prompt with `buildCriticPrompt` (no diff re-feed), runs it through `sessionManager.sendGitAiQuery`, and parses verdicts with `parseCriticVerdicts` / `applyCriticVerdicts`.
- If the primary provider fails, retries once via `resolvePeerReviewAgent` (the opposite provider).

### 8. Peer review (lines 1254-1260, method `runPeerReviewPass`)
Cross-provider second opinion: if primary is Claude, peer is Codex (gpt-5.5), and vice versa (line 674).
- Builds the audit prompt with `buildPeerReviewPrompt` from **`./pr-review-peer-review`**.
- Sends it through `sessionManager.sendGitAiQuery` on the peer provider.
- Parses changes with `parsePeerReviewChanges` / `applyPeerReviewChanges`, then re-deduplicates with `deduplicateFindings`.
- Persists the `SecondOpinionSummary` to `pr_reviews.second_opinion_summary_json`.

### 9. Thread assignment (line 1261)
`assignFindingThreads` builds per-finding fingerprints (`domain|file|lineBucket|normalizedTitle`) and matches them against existing `pr_review_threads` rows. New fingerprints get new thread rows; matches update `last_seen_review_id` and set `statusInRun` to `'new'` or `'persisting'`.

### 10. Revalidation pass (lines 1277-1318, lazy import)
Only runs if `includeRevalidation && scope.reviewMode === 'incremental'`. Dynamically imports **`./revalidation-worker`** and calls `runRevalidationPass`, which re-checks unmatched threads that touch the changed files. Uses `runRevalidationSession` (a thin wrapper over `sessionManager`) per thread.

### 11. Thread lifecycle (line 1320)
`applyThreadLifecycle` carries forward threads from prior reviews that were not touched by this run, stamping them `'resolved'` (full mode) or `'persisting'` / `'needs_revalidation'` (incremental mode).

### 12. Persistence (lines 1325-1378)
Bulk-inserts all `ThreadAssignment` entries into `pr_review_findings` via `getDb()` (**`./db`**). Updates `pr_reviews` status to `'done'` with cost and timestamp. Updates `pr_review_series.latest_review_id`.

### 13. Final IPC push (line 1387)
Broadcasts the complete result over `IPC.GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` with all findings, cost, snapshot SHAs, summary counts, and per-agent progress to the renderer.

## `startReview` — the synchronous preamble (lines 903-1015)

Before any real work begins, `startReview` does bookkeeping and returns immediately:

2. **Series + mode decision**: `ensureReviewSeries()` upserts a row in `pr_review_series`; `getLatestSuccessfulReviewBaseline()` retrieves the last passing review. If the base SHA matches and a prior head SHA exists, the mode is `incremental`; otherwise it falls back to `full`.
3. **Initial persistence**: a row is inserted into `pr_reviews` (via `db.ts` / `sqlite-adapter.ts`) with `status='running'`, both SHAs, and the tentative mode.
4. **IPC broadcast**: `this.send(IPC.GH_REVIEW_UPDATE, { status: 'running', agentProgress: [...] })` pushes the initial state to the renderer.
5. **Async fire-and-forget**: `this.runParallelReview(...)` is called without `await`. `startReview` returns the skeleton `PrReview` object; all real work happens below.

## `runParallelReview` — the orchestration engine (lines 1017-1413)

### 1. Worktree + diff/scope resolution

### 2. Context building (`pr-context/`)

A `PrContextBuilder` (module: `src/main/pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`) is instantiated with two backends:

- **MCP backend** (`src/main/pr-context/mcp-context-backend.ts` + `mcp-client.ts`): wraps `CodeIntelligenceMcpClient` to call the code-intelligence MCP server for changed-file symbols, cross-references, and related tests.
- **Heuristic backend** (`src/main/pr-context/heuristic-context-backend.ts`): regex/AST-based fallback used when MCP is unavailable or times out.

`builder.build({ diff, worktreePath, pr, totalTimeoutMs: 20_000 })` runs (20 s budget), emitting `IPC.GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE` events for progress. Failure is non-fatal; agents proceed without the bundle.

### 3. Parallel agent dispatch

```

Promise.allSettled(agentPromises)
```

One AI agent session per focus area (`security`, `correctness`, `performance`, etc.) runs concurrently via `runAgentSession` (class method, line 1668). Each session gets the diff chunks, skipped-file list, MCP config, and model/effort settings. After all settle, the worktree is torn down via `removePrWorktree(reviewId)`.

`deduplicateFindings(allFindings)` (module: `src/main/pr-review-dedupe.ts`, line 223) merges near-duplicate findings from different agents using deterministic clustering.

### 5. Critic pass then peer review

In sequence (not parallel):

- `runCriticPass(reviewId, cwd, deduped, reviewAgent)` (class method, line 1458): a single agent session that filters out low-signal findings.
- `runPeerReviewPass(reviewId, cwd, scopedDetail, filtered, reviewAgent)` (class method, line 1515): a second agent improves/annotates the survivors.
- `assignFindingThreads(reviewId, peerReviewed)` (class method, line 744): links each finding to a persistent `pr_review_threads` row for cross-run continuity.

### 6. Revalidation (incremental runs only)

Dynamically imported: `const { runRevalidationPass } = await import('./revalidation-worker')`. Given the set of touched files and the open threads from prior runs, it runs `runRevalidationSession` (class method, line 1415) to verdict each old issue as `resolved`, `persisting`, or `stale`. Thread status rows are updated in SQLite and `resolveMappedCommentsForOutcomes()` auto-dismisses resolved GitHub PR comments.

### 7. Thread lifecycle

`applyThreadLifecycle(reviewId, scope.reviewMode, touchedFiles, [...assignments])` (class method, line 838) classifies all findings as `new`, `persisting`, `resolved`, or `stale` and returns the final `ThreadAssignment[]`.

### 8. Persistence and final broadcast

- Each `ThreadAssignment` is INSERTed into `pr_review_findings` (SQLite via `db.ts` / `sqlite-adapter.ts`).
- `pr_review_series.latest_review_id` is updated.
- `updateReviewStatus(reviewId, 'done', Date.now(), totalCost)` writes the final status and USD cost.
- `hydratePostUrls(finalFindings)` enriches findings with any existing GitHub comment URLs already posted.
- A final `IPC.GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` with `status: 'done'`, all findings, the cost summary, and per-agent progress is broadcast to the renderer.

`startReview` itself does only pre-flight work before returning immediately:

- **`resolveReviewAgent()`** (internal) picks model/provider/effort from options or defaults.
- **`getPrDetail()`** (`gh-cli.ts:209`) shells out to the GitHub CLI to fetch PR metadata: head/base SHAs, branch names, title.
- **`ensureReviewSeries()` / `getLatestSuccessfulReviewBaseline()`** (internal, `pr_review_series` table) decide whether this run is `full` or `incremental` by comparing the new `baseSha` against the previous review's baseline.
- A row is inserted into `pr_reviews` via `getDb()` (`db.ts` / `sqlite-adapter.ts`) with status `'running'`.
- An initial `GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` IPC event is sent to the renderer.
- **`runParallelReview()`** is fired with `.catch()` — not awaited — so `startReview` returns a `PrReview` object immediately while review work proceeds asynchronously.

---

### 2. Worktree + scope (inside `runParallelReview`, lines 1038-1079)

- **`createPrWorktree()`** (internal, uses `git-worktree-service.ts`) creates an isolated git worktree at `~/.pylon/worktrees/` on the PR's head branch. Falls back to `repo.projectPath` on failure.
- **`resolveReviewScope()`** (`review-scope.ts:49`) fetches the diff: full PR diff for a `full` run, or just the commits since the last review's `headSha` for an `incremental` run. Returns a `ReviewScopeResult` with the diff string and file list.
- **`chunkDiff()`** (`diff-chunker.ts:385`) splits the diff into token-budget-respecting chunks, skipping lockfiles and generated files. Token budget is derived from `getTokenBudget()` in the same module, optionally informed by `sessionManager.getModelContextWindow()`.

---

### 3. Context building (lines 1125-1201)

A `PrContextBuilder` (`pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`) is constructed with two backends:

- **`McpContextBackend`** (`pr-context/`) wraps a `CodeIntelligenceMcpClient` and calls code-intelligence MCP tools (symbol lookup, references, etc.) to build rich context.
- **`HeuristicContextBackend`** (`pr-context/`) is the fallback: it parses the diff heuristically.

`builder.build()` tries MCP first; if unavailable or timing out (20s total / 8s per call), it falls back to heuristic and returns a `'degraded'` bundle. The result is written as `.pylon/pr-context.json` inside the worktree. `GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE` events are sent at `building` and `done/fallback/error` phases.

---

### 4. Parallel specialist agents (lines 1205-1225)

One **`runAgentSession()`** call is launched per `ReviewFocus` area (e.g., `security`, `correctness`, `performance`, etc.) via `Promise.allSettled()`. Each agent:

- Creates a provider session via `sessionManager.createSession()` (`session-manager.ts`) on the configured model.
- Sets `auto-approve` permissions and the configured effort level.
- Sends each diff chunk as a message and collects structured `ReviewFinding[]` responses.
- Progress events (`GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` with `agentProgress`) stream back to the renderer per chunk.

After all settle, the worktree is cleaned up via `removePrWorktree()`.

---

### 5. Dedupe (line 1249)

**`deduplicateFindings()`** (`pr-review-dedupe.ts:223`) merges near-duplicate findings from all agents using a dice-coefficient string similarity measure over tokenized title+description+location. Findings within a ±3-line window that exceed the similarity threshold are merged into one.

---

### 6. Critic pass (lines 1253, `runCriticPass` at line 1458)

Implements a generator+critic pattern:

- **`partitionForCritic()`** (internal) splits findings: high-severity/anchored/must-fix ones bypass the critic and pass through directly; the rest become candidates.
- **`buildCriticPrompt()`** (internal) constructs a compact prompt (no diff re-feed) for the candidates.
- A short-lived session via `sessionManager.sendGitAiQuery()` runs the critic. If the primary provider fails, **`resolvePeerReviewAgent()`** selects the other available provider and retries once.
- The critic's JSON response is parsed and findings not approved are dropped.

---

### 7. Peer review pass (lines 1254-1260, `runPeerReviewPass` at line 1515)

A second LLM pass that validates the critic-filtered findings against the PR detail (title, base/head branches). Another `sessionManager.sendGitAiQuery()` call — same pattern as the critic but with a peer-review-specific prompt.

---

### 8. Revalidation (lines 1270-1318, incremental runs only)

Dynamically imported from **`revalidation-worker.ts`** to keep the module boundary clean. `runRevalidationPass()` checks previous review findings whose source files were touched in the new commits — calling `runRevalidationSession()` (which spins up another `sessionManager` session) per thread, then emitting `resolved`, `persisting`, or `stale` verdicts. Resolved threads auto-close their mapped GitHub comments via `resolveMappedCommentsForOutcomes()` (`gh-cli.ts`).

---

### 9. Thread lifecycle (lines 1320-1323)

**`assignFindingThreads()`** and **`applyThreadLifecycle()`** (internal) map each finding to a persistent `pr_review_threads` DB row, assigning `statusInRun` values (`new`, `persisting`, `resolved`, `stale`) so the UI and GitHub comment posting can track findings across review runs.

---

### 10. Persistence (lines 1326-1378)

All findings are bulk-inserted into `pr_review_findings` via a prepared statement on `getDb()`. Then:

- `updateReviewSummary()` writes a `ReviewRunSummary` JSON (new/persisting/resolved/stale counts) to `pr_reviews`.
- `updateReviewStatus()` marks the review `'done'` with a timestamp and aggregated cost from `sumAgentCosts()`.
- `pr_review_series.latest_review_id` is updated so the next run can find this as its baseline.

---

### 11. Final IPC push (lines 1387-1412)

`GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` with `status: 'done'`, all findings (with `postUrl` hydrated from `hydratePostUrls()`), cost, snapshot SHAs, and per-agent progress is sent to the renderer. `activeReviews` map entry is deleted.

---

**Supporting modules at a glance:**

| Step | Module |
|---|---|
| Diff fetch | `gh-cli.ts` (`getPrDetail`) |
| Scope/diff range | `review-scope.ts` |
| Diff chunking | `diff-chunker.ts` |
| Context building | `pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`, `pr-context/mcp-context-backend.ts`, `pr-context/heuristic-context-backend.ts` |
| Agent sessions | `session-manager.ts` (all LLM calls) |
| Dedupe | `pr-review-dedupe.ts` |
| Critic/peer-review prompts | internal `buildCriticPrompt()` in `pr-review-manager.ts` |
| Revalidation | `revalidation-worker.ts` |
| DB | `db.ts` + `sqlite-adapter.ts` |
| GitHub comment ops | `gh-cli.ts` (`postFindingComment`, `appendToPullRequestReviewComment`) |
